1.consolidated_definition: Programa del ordenador que permite la elaboración y corrección de documentos antes de ser impresos. Anglicismo crudo, usual. La apelante en dicho lugar, su función era básicamente clasificar correspondencia y utilizando el word processor pasaba documentos (Informe de Oficial Examinador, PR, consultado 23-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Computer program that allows the creation and correction of documents before they are printed. Raw Anglicism, commonly used. In said place, its function was essentially to classify correspondence and using a word processor would pass on documents (Examiner's Report, PR, consulted 23-10-08)
